title: PUBG Mobile 4.7 on GameLoop: Update and Controls Guide
summary: Prepare GameLoop for PUBG Mobile 4.7 with supported updates, keymapping checks and performance troubleshooting.
intro: PUBG Mobile's 4.7 winter release has new themed movement and possible Classic Mode adjustments. GameLoop players should approach the transition differently from phone players because keyboard mappings, rendering modes and emulator versions introduce extra compatibility questions. This guide focuses on safe checks without claiming that every new mobile feature will work identically on Windows immediately.

sections.heading: Update through supported software channels
paragraphs: Use the GameLoop interface and the game's supported update mechanism instead of replacing game packages with files found in chat groups. A popular download labeled early 4.7 can be outdated, modified or malicious. If the official update has not arrived, check release timing and the emulator's compatibility notices. Avoid changing Android package identifiers or protected game files to try to reveal an unreleased event.

sections.heading: Keep a copy of your preferred mapping
paragraphs: Before updating, record your commonly used movement, inventory, firing and camera keys. Special abilities may require new interface controls or slightly different placements. After installing the update, run a training session to confirm that entering and leaving vehicles, opening the backpack and switching weapons behave normally. Do not assume a single leaked keymap from another emulator version is a universal solution.

sections.heading: Distinguish input lag from server problems
paragraphs: A delay between mouse movement and the camera could come from frame-time spikes, keymapping or local system load. An enemy teleporting during a match points more toward network or server conditions. Check resource usage, background recording software and the selected monitor refresh rate before blaming the game patch. Keep one change at a time so you can tell what actually helped.

sections.heading: Understand new themed mechanics carefully
paragraphs: The beta's Aurora Flashstep and Pegasus involve controls that make sense on a touchscreen but may need specific emulator support. A video recorded on a phone does not establish a working GameLoop shortcut. If an ability cannot be activated, verify that the event is live in your selected mode and that the emulator supports its input before using unsupported scripts. New features can roll out in stages.

sections.heading: Protect your account and PC
paragraphs: Avoid alleged all-skins patches, fake FPS boosters and remote-support accounts demanding login credentials. Keep Windows, graphics drivers and ordinary malware protection current. Secure the login service linked to PUBG Mobile and never share one-time verification codes. A legitimate update should not require turning off every security feature or installing an unrelated browser extension.

sections.heading: Troubleshoot with reversible changes
paragraphs: If mouse control feels inconsistent after updating, begin with a familiar training scene rather than reinstalling everything. Check the selected mode, keyboard mappings, display resolution, frame-time consistency and heavy background tasks. Change only one setting at a time and compare the same movement. Save a screenshot of your working controls. If a new feature cannot be activated, verify that its event is live and the emulator supports it. Do not install an unsigned input script or altered client just to imitate a phone recording.
